# Continuous build Changelog

## Changes

- [#419](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/419) #414: architectural programs — who built it decides the floor plan — Zuljita
- [#422](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/422) Fix #421: the physical world is not rules content — book gates remain on monsters, magic, and treasure — Zuljita
- [#427](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/427) #274 third slice: tag-set knobs, set-piece + source-matrix composites, conditionalOn — Zuljita

- [#430](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/430) #424 S2/S3/S5: site commissions — contract, digest, and the loopback API (decisions 1-5) — Zuljita
- [#431](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/431) #424 wrap: polish wiring, region enrichment, faction carry, requested exports — Zuljita
- [#433](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/433) Forward usesFatigueOrSpell to the rating profile so the halving actually applies — Zuljita
- [#435](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/435) Documentation audit: accuracy, single-owner paths, dead-code removal, and a drift gate — Zuljita
- [#436](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/436) Consolidate stringArray/clamp local copies into src/utils/collections.ts — Zuljita
- [#437](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/437) Sprint: close the pre-launch backlog — open trap floor, set pieces, solitary cap, and export QA against a live Foundry — Zuljita
- [#434](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/434) Build Windows on every push via self-hosted runners, gated on availability — Zuljita
- [#438](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/438) Cloud provider support for director LLM calls (#119) — Zuljita
- [#439](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/439) Drag-to-move panels, drop-created bottom strip, and remount-proof docking (#268) — Zuljita
- [#440](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/440) Vertical links as first-class validated graph edges (#13) — Zuljita
- [#441](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/441) Help menu: Report a Bug opens the public issue tracker — Zuljita
- [#450](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/450) Fix About reporting 0.0.0, and art-pack list rebuilding on every tick — Zuljita
  - Fix About reporting 0.0.0, and art-pack list rebuilding on every tick
  - Map docs/self-hosted-runners.md into AGENTS.md §3.1
- [#451](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/451) Unbreak the Windows build: drop `shell: bash` from the version stamp — Zuljita
- [#453](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/453) Ramp danger by walked distance from the entrance, and allow single-biome sites — Zuljita
- [#454](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/454) Art packs: library-wide Select all, bulk index progress, discovery defaults to enabled — Zuljita
  - Art packs: library-wide Select all, bulk index progress, discovery defaults to enabled (#445)
  - Shorten the tag-pass notice to the number that matters (#445)
- [#455](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/455) Make the Dungeondraft export actually work: blank maps, invisible objects, floors, asset variety, lights in walls — Zuljita
  - Reach art by family name, and fold artist tag namespaces (#445)
  - Write crosswalk patterns bare, now that namespaces fold generically (#445)
  - Seed family matching from the room, not the pack's own tags (#445)
  - Judged art run + Dungeondraft export harness (#445)
  - Synthesized Dungeondraft fixture was missing the `mod` key, so exports would not open (#445)
  - Fix Dungeondraft export: blank maps and invisible objects (#445)
  - The blank map was a missing editor_state.color_palettes (#445)
  - Paint room floors into the tile layer, tinted (#445)
  - Map features to Dungeondraft's real asset library (#445)
  - Place room lights inside the room (#445)
  - Sweep the room-centre assumption; one helper, five call sites (#445)
- [#457](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/457) Make lighting declared data, not keyword-matched prose (#456) — Zuljita
  - Make lighting declared data, not keyword-matched prose (#456)
  - Make darkness the default: a room is lit only where a source belongs (#456)
- [#458](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/458) Issue cleanup sprint: #442, #445, #447, #448, #449 — Zuljita
  - Rank the interview's vocabulary chips, and stop naming one after a dial (#449)
  - Bound the art-pack tag-view derivation before Select All can weaponize it (#445)
  - Director's Commentary: a real panel, and a surface the interview can use (#448, #447)
  - Hachure the rock's edge instead of scribbling over all of it (#442)
  - Note that Stage Manager is the internal name; the panel is Director's Commentary (#448)
- [#459](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/459) Headless InterviewSession: the sequencer the interview never had (#446, part 1 of 2) — Zuljita
  - Rehome interview-steps under generation/intent (#446 W1)
  - The dungeon interview as a callable object (#446 W2)
- [#460](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/460) Banter reports the work: ~75% of lines are about what the model is doing — Zuljita
- [#488](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/488) Known-issues sprint: #474, #485, #484, #486, #464, #487 — Zuljita
  - Measure the brief, and actually run the quality gate (#474)
  - Say seven where the docs said five, and name the fixture honestly (#474)
  - "Most" dead ends now means most dead ends (#485)
  - Stop rolling dice for the treasure dial the GM already set (#484)
  - A premise describes a place, not the party (#486)
  - Cite the page the package names, not an anchor that never resolved (#464)
  - Sweep the dead config, drifted tables and stale docs (#487)
- [#461](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/461) Build(deps-dev): Bump brace-expansion from 1.1.15 to 1.1.18 — Zuljita
- [#462](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/462) Build(deps-dev): Bump undici from 6.27.0 to 6.28.0 — Zuljita
- [#463](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/463) Build(deps-dev): Bump fast-uri from 3.1.4 to 3.1.5 — Zuljita
- [#495](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/495) Pin monster library 0.5.1: 457 citations that open a real page (#464) — Zuljita
- [#496](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/496) Harden the monster package's deferred-field checks on top of #495 — Zuljita
  - Grade the monster package's deferred fields per source, not per package
- [#498](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/498) Generator controls: close nine of epic #477, and say what the audit got wrong — Zuljita
  - Stop `derived` from meaning "the GM owns this book" (#478, #479, #482, #491)
  - Regenerate REGISTRY.md for the shared depth-band exports
  - Pick which quantity is depth, and make the code obey it (#492)
  - Move door access and water bias into biomes.json (#490)
  - Stop the commission socket ignoring the dungeonSize it was handed (#494)
  - Declare how many fights there are, not just how hard (#480)
  - Make biome dominance a control instead of a rule (#481)
  - Point the biomeDominance default comment at the filed issue (#497)
  - Fix eight things an adversarial review pass found
  - Say what actually dropped from the default source pool (#478)
- [#499](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/499) Sprint: #497 scoped-reroll containment (+ mixed default), #469 enclosure axis, #476 biomeCount knob — Zuljita
- [#500](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/500) Sprint: #493 number knobs in the interview, #476 premise-proposed biome count, #483 dangerHint consumption — Zuljita
  - Sprint: #493 number knobs reach the interview, #476 the premise proposes a biome count, #483 the hint stops reverting the GM
- [#501](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/501) Sprint: #489 package-tag dispositions, #472 unique grounded room names — Zuljita
  - Sprint: #489 every package tag gets a disposition, #472 rooms get real unique names
  - Pre-align the crosswalk with the monster library's incoming closed vocabulary
- [#502](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/502) Decor gets prerequisites, a memory, and the brief's ear (#471) — Zuljita
- [#503](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/503) Sprint: #468 the brief reaches biome selection, #475 site and occupancy split into orthogonal axes — Zuljita
  - A sewer brief can now put a sewer on the map (#468)
  - Site and occupancy are orthogonal axes, and now the generator agrees (#475)
- [#507](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/507) Sprint: #467 the brief's prose becomes tags, #466 differential tag carry — Zuljita
- [#508](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/508) Sprint: #470 who you meet obeys the occupancy, #473 the requested chapel IS a chapel — Zuljita
- [#509](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/509) Follow-ups: #505 every pickable tag pulls something, #506 no slash-composites in room names — Zuljita
- [#510](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/510) The brief is declared: five of seven fields are knobs, commissions state it structurally (#483) — Zuljita
  - The brief is declared: five of seven fields are knobs, and commissions state it structurally (#483)
- [#511](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/511) Directors findable everywhere, first-run tour, Vorga casts brief characters, interview-match benchmark — Zuljita
  - Directors you can always find, a first-run tour, Vorga casts the brief's characters, and the interview-match benchmark
- [#512](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/512) Make the interview appear in the generation: outline-planned sites, intake backstop, room keys that speak the brief — Zuljita
  - The interview appears in the generation: outline-planned sites, premise-word backstop, and room keys that speak the brief
  - The plan is the dungeon: outline rooms bind by name and type, every brief tag reaches a room, the brief stays the GM's words
  - Brief tags discriminate: a selection-time saturation ceiling and rarest-first room keys
- [#516](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/516) Room-name vocabulary is data: tag-keyed word lists carry the small-model floor (#513) — Zuljita
  - Room-name vocabulary is data: tag-keyed word lists carry the small-model floor (#513)
  - First-run onboarding stops claiming a local LLM is needed
  - First-run copy tells the truth the right way round: the model is the point
- [#517](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/517) User-selectable install location for local models (managed runtime) — Zuljita
  - Local models install where the GM says: model storage gains a movable directory
- [#522](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/522) Every panel stays reachable at 1080p: rollups stop shrink-clipping, plus an automated resolution smoke — Zuljita
  - Every panel stays reachable at 1080p: rollups stop shrink-clipping, and a resolution smoke pins it
- [#524](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/524) Challenge gains True Random (#518): rooms roll the monster pool's whole spectrum — Zuljita
  - Challenge gains True Random: every room rolls the monster pool's whole spectrum, and Party CER stops being homework
- [#527](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/527) Rescue Room Forge (#520): the merged PR #523 never reached main — Zuljita
  - Forge one room to order: the room commission API, and the Room Forge rail panel that serves it
- [#526](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/526) Resolution smoke covers the full desktop landscape: 2K/4K scale factors, 16:10, all ultrawide classes — Zuljita
  - The resolution smoke covers the desktop landscape: 2K and 4K at their common scale factors, 16:10, and every ultrawide class
- [#525](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/525) Settings → GCS: point the app at a GCS install that isn't where we guessed — Zuljita
  - Settings → GCS: point the app at a GCS install that isn't where we guessed
  - GCS has no installer — stop pretending discovery is the normal path
- [#515](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/515) Build(deps-dev): Bump electron from 39.8.5 to 39.8.10 — Zuljita
- [#514](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/514) Build(deps): Bump js-yaml from 4.2.0 to 4.3.1 — Zuljita
- [#528](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/528) Put the pane splitters where the seam is, and draw them (#521) — Zuljita
- [#529](https://github.com/Zuljita/DungeonsOnAutomatic/pull/529) Publish a pull-request changelog that actually reaches the public site — Zuljita
  - Publish a pull-request changelog that reaches the public site
